operations.description:
The Copyrights API returns copyright information for
the Maps API Raster Tile Service in JSON, JSONP, or XML format.
This call returns copyright information for the whole world.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map copyrights format [PARAMS] callback format number version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This API returns copyright captions for the map service.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map copyrights caption format [PARAMS] callback format number version [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
The Copyrights API returns copyright information for
the Maps API Raster Tile Service in JSON, JSONP, or XML format.
This call returns copyright information for a specific bounding box.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map copyrights [PARAMS] callback format lat lon max min number version [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
The Copyrights API returns copyright information for
the Maps API Raster Tile Service in JSON, JSONP, or XML format.
This call returns copyright information for the a specific map tile.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map copyrights [PARAMS] callback format number version x y zoom [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
The Static Image service renders a rectangular raster image
in the style, size, and zoom level specified. The image can be requested
using either a center point plus width and height or a bounding box.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map staticimage [PARAMS] bbox center format height layer number style version view width zoom [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The Maps API Vector Service delivers vector tiles, which are representations of square sections of map data.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map tile y pbf [PARAMS] language layer number style version view x y zoom [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The Maps API Raster Service delivers raster tiles, which are representations of square sections of map data.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map tile [PARAMS] format layer number size style tile version view x y zoom [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
The GetMap call implements the Web Map Service 1.1.1 standard
to access TomTom raster map tiles. This service is described
in the response to the GetCapabilities API call.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] map [PATH] map wms [PARAMS] bbox format height layers number request service srs styles version width [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
The GetCapabilities call is part of TomTom's implementation of version 1.1.1
the Web Map Service (WMS). It provides descriptions of the other calls
that are available in the implementation.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] capabilities [PATH] map wms [PARAMS] number request service version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The WMTS GetCapabilities call implements version 1.0.0 of the Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) standard. It returns metadata that allows compatible calling systems to construct calls to TomTom's raster map tile service. See the documentation for more information on WMTS.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] map wmts wmts capabilities xml [PARAMS] key number version wmts [SCHEMA]
